limitations: Replicated states exercise batched query parallelism, not varied simultaneous games.

Path validation does not enumerate all game actions or commit movements, and does not measure search or learning.
This compares route queries, not complete GPU gameplay or search.
The preparation profile predates the separate income-refresh correction; the paired reference/fused measurements both use the corrected contract.
